claim_boundary: Pure source simulation of exact generation restore, bound suffix replay, checkpoint drift reporting, and restart reconciliation. It performs no actual rollback or restart, provider/model/evaluator execution, Trace append, training, promotion, deployment, or fleet action.

capabilities.name: restore_generation
capabilities.description: Reconstruct and validate an exact prior checkpoint from the descendant's self-contained ancestry.

capabilities.name: replay_suffix
capabilities.description: Replay a contiguous, bound generation suffix and require canonical equality with the original descendant.

capabilities.name: detect_drift
capabilities.description: Compare every checkpoint identity surface and return a content-addressed drift report.

capabilities.name: reconcile_restart
capabilities.description: Accept only an exact branch and head; all drift returns a typed blocker.

required: plain-integer target generation present in ancestry
contiguous generation replay suffix with committed actions and explicit tails
all authority false and all execution counters zero
preconditions: the current and observed checkpoints independently validate
the target is not before genesis or after the current generation
replay steps are exact, contiguous, nonempty, and preserve tail boundaries
the expected current checkpoint remains immutable throughout evaluation

output_contract.success: An exact rollback plan, restored checkpoint, replayed checkpoint, zero-drift report, and accepted exact-branch restart receipt.
output_contract.failure: A typed target, suffix, checkpoint, drift, authority, or counter blocker; no partial acceptance.
output_contract.verification: Rebuild and compare canonical bytes for restore, replay, drift report, and restart receipt.

delta_c.rule: A rollback target must be byte-identical to the original ancestor entry and prefix.
Replay and restart may accept only the exact original branch and head.

out_of_scope: actual rollback, process restart, or service reconciliation
training, promotion, deployment, or fleet rollout

steps: 1. Validate the exact current checkpoint and requested target generation.
2. Reconstruct the target checkpoint from its ancestor core and exact prefix.
3. Replay every generation in the supplied suffix, preserving committed actions and excluded tails.
4. Require the replayed checkpoint to equal the original descendant byte-for-byte.
5. Compare scenario, generation, predecessor, action journal, head, state, tail, ancestry, and checkpoint hashes.
6. Accept restart reconciliation only when no drift field exists.
done_definition: rollback target equals the original ancestor
replayed suffix equals the original current checkpoint
forked or stale restart state is detected
all authority remains false and counters remain zero
repair_on_failure: localize the first differing generation or checkpoint field and rebuild from the last exact ancestor
never coerce, ignore, or relabel drift as equivalence

exec_block_rules.when: any operational authority or execution counter is nonzero
restore, replay, drift comparison, or restart branch is not exactly derivable
